christians-reading-classics.title: Dostoevsky's Crime & Punishment, with Perry Glanzer
christians-reading-classics.description: A man decides he can do one terrible thing for the greater good. The fallout isn’t just legal trouble, it’s the slow collapse of his own soul. Author and educator Perry Glanzer helps us take Dostoevsky’s Crime & Punishment seriously as Christians, not for ideals it champions, but for naming the spiritual cost of dehumanizing people and trying to outthink conscience.
